_comment: Single source of truth for daemon::adapters::parse_session_health_pane (bead rev-cbzll). Fatal auth/quota/error substrings scraped from tmux pane text across vendor coding CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, agy, cursor-agent). Order matters only for the 'individual quota reached' special-case that folds a trailing 'resets in' countdown into the returned reason. ponytail: this is pane-text keyword scraping — false-negative risk if a vendor CLI changes its banner wording; the durable upgrade path is self-reported health from the coder process instead of scraping terminal output.
